newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls marginally on London's falls.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls marginally on London's falls.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia fell nine cents to end at 15.07 ringgit ($5.97) a kg as the market took its cue from a lower London market overnight.
Traders said an initial high offering also pushed down the price. They saw an opening offer of 138 tonnes against bids of 94. Turnover settled at 97 tonnes, versus 91 on Thursday.

"The market was slightly easier due to London's falls," a trader said, adding the near-term trend depended largely on copper's movement in London. The local price was at a premium of $40 a tonne over the London Metal Exchange against $60 previously.
